dataset.description: Specify which dataset to generate. It can be one of `features`, `masks`, or `target`.

timePeriod.description: The time period for which the plots will be generated. By default, plots are generated for the  `training` period.

timeRange.description:
Use this field to specify a custom time range for which to generate data. If specified, it will override the `timePeriod`
field. One of `timePeriod` or `timeRange` must be specified.

masksToUse.description:
By default, the plots will be generated for all the masks that are applied during training. If the user wants to
plot the default masks that are applied during inference, the user can set this field to
```
masksToUse = ['mask_IsAssetNotOperational', 'mask_AssetEvent', 'mask_PostAssetEvent', 'mask_AdHocInference']
```

title: This spec is used to configure how to generate plots using the `ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#plot` API.
name: ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRunPlottingSpec
